worldcombat.skill.camouflage.summary: Reads the ground underfoot and temporarily dyes the body into its type: water in water, grass in grass, rock in a cave. With Drift on, it keeps re-reading the ground while the coat holds.
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.use.0: Become a type that fits the terrain underfoot
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.use.1: Flip your incoming matchups and type immunities
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.use.2: Set a type from the terrain before a fight
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.description: Crouches to read the ground after a %1$s s wind-up; whatever material it reads becomes the new type.
The coat lasts %1$s s; matchups, same-type bonus and type immunities settle on the new type while it holds.
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.drift.0: Drift: while the coat holds it re-reads the ground every 20 ticks and switches type when the material changed (keeping the remaining coat time, not extending it); adaptable, but the terrain can hand you a bad type, and cooldown is +10 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.drift.1: Fixed coat: set once and ignore the terrain; cooldown −6 ticks, but the type no longer fits once you leave the spot.
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.growth.0: From level %1$s, cooldown is reduced by an extra 0.5 seconds.
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.growth.1: From level %1$s, the extra cooldown reduction becomes 0.9 seconds, replacing the earlier reduction.
On: re-reads and changes type as you stand on different ground, adaptable but the terrain can hand you a bad type and cooldown is +10 ticks. Off: set once, cooldown −6 ticks, but the type no longer fits after you leave the spot.
worldcombat.skill.camouflage.description: It reads the fluid and block underfoot: water, ice, grass, sandy soil, stone and ores (end stone included), and fire or lava (netherrack included) read as Water / Ice / Grass / Ground / Rock / Fire; with no matching material it falls back by dimension (the Nether to Fire, the End to Rock), otherwise Normal.

The coat is a single type that replaces your whole typing (even a dual type collapses into it); the original type returns the moment the coat expires, is cleansed, or the caster leaves. It cannot be used when you are already exactly that single type.
